title: adhatoda patula
intro: Adhatoda patula, commonly known as Vasa or Malabar nut, is a plant species native to the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, and as an anti-inflammatory agent to reduce fever and alleviate pain. The therapeutic actions of Adhatoda patula are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including vasicine and vasicinone, which exhibit expectorant and bronchodilatory properties, making it an effective treatment for respiratory disorders. The plant's leaves and bark contain various alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides that contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic applications.
